items.title: DETERMINISTIC LIVENESS DETECTOR: liveness is a computed query behind a CLI, never a recorded fact (Mike's ruling 2026-09-01). DEFECT: liveness is defined on agent-authored rows. effort_checkin.ex counts EFFECT as exactly artifacts, attests, or work-item updates; its moduledoc says "Turns and workspace writes are effort, never effect", and the turn count is gathered at :1215-1227 then excluded from effect?/1 at :1229-1231. A physical question is answered with testimony while the physical record is discarded. DRIFT: recorded liveness diverges from reality and agents act on the record; wi_a57dee58 measured 11 entitlements against hundreds of open cards and 301 exhausted ladders. NON-DISCRIMINATION: attest-absence cannot tell DEAD from BUSY, both being silent. Specimen 2026-08-31 gibson: the guidance-audit session was dead 4h on an exhausted budget, turns failing usageLimitExceeded, while the Toplines Lane 2 coder was healthy mid-build; identical to the effect predicate, separated in a minute from the turns table. Liveness failures are MECHANICAL (exhausted budget, wedged turns, adapter shutdown, retired session) and unattestable by definition. RULING: compute liveness from the PHYSICAL RECORD ON DEMAND; never store it. Agents ASK; they never read a recorded fact and are never required to run forensics. WANTED: (a) a deterministic predicate over evidence needing no agent cooperation: turn rows (status, timestamps, error, adapterGen), wake state, session existence; (b) a CLI verb asking whether a session, assignment, or work item is lively; (c) when NOT lively, the same call returns exactly WHY with the deciding evidence, so the caller needs no follow-up forensics; (d) no recorded liveness state anywhere. PRESERVE: pacing is a SCHEDULE, not a claim, and stays a row. OUT OF SCOPE: whether work is ADVANCING is semantic and keeps the trust model where an attest is the agent's account. ROUTE UNDER: wi_a57dee58, wi_990f7b7e, wi_3cdaf683.

Prods the session's spawnedBy parent to CONSIDER retirement; the parent decides, Tightbeam never retires on its own (Mike: the agent may know something the ledger does not). If the parent is dormant or retired, climb to the nearest living authority (constitution line 16); unowned sessions roll to Main. If the same child survives N sweeps unanswered, the next prod goes to the grandparent. T scales with priority per the card-inactivity ruling (wi_8001dea8). GATE: rides the prodder's existing harness-down pause via harness_health_incidents and inherits the new failure classes from wi_6c74884c; it must NOT carry its own harness-up check. items.title: CREDENTIAL FAILURE MUST BACK OFF, REDIRECT, AND SAY SO (Mike ruling 2026-09-03). Specimen: gibson's Anthropic credential was revoked; the catalog kept re-probing it, every claude spawn on gibson was refused with catalog_unavailable, and work silently rerouted to racter. (2) REDIRECT — routing the work to a host that can still serve it is CORRECT and stays; that part is not the bug. (3) BE LOUD ABOUT BOTH — one standing, human-visible statement that says the host lost the harness, that work is being rerouted, and what fixes it: e.g. 'gibson: Anthropic credential revoked; claude work routing to racter; gibson needs a sign-in.' NOT IN SCOPE (Mike explicitly rejected as over-engineering): proactive refresh timers, rewiring Tightbeam to reference the harness credential store, or otherwise trying to be more durable than the harness's own OAuth. A credential expiring after idle and needing a human sign-in is normal; the defect is only in what happens AFTER the failure. Untargeted; both lines eventually, main first.

So pending_wake only ever suppresses the substrate's own duplicate prod; an agent-armed continuation can NEVER credit. Surfaced by coder:turn-timeout-incident (att_e937ea90) during the turn-timeout ship: the deploy STAGING (npm install of 5795df1) already replaced the systemd service's binary on disk BEFORE the build was verified-green + the ship authorized — so a spontaneous systemd restart (Restart=on-failure / crash) would load the RED 5795df1 bytes, while the RUNNING process (old PID 1564543) is the prior good binary held in memory. AND the old good binary FILE was overwritten by the install -> NO safe prior CI artifact staged for an authorized rollback. TWO defects: (1) STAGE-BEFORE-VERIFY — the deploy must NOT overwrite the live systemd binary until the artifact is verified-green AND the ship is authorized (stage to a side path, atomic-swap only on go); a red/unverified build must never become restart-loadable. (2) NO-ROLLBACK-ARTIFACT — the prior good artifact must be preserved (not overwritten) so an authorized rollback is always possible. Mitigated THIS incident by: known-regression-is-test-only (production likely-correct) + the green artifact (test-double fix wi_3f9e524c) will replace the red on disk. Kin to the atomic-deploy / release-ceremony safety lane. Substrate-reliability / deploy-safety.

items.title: 0.2 DESIGN — supervision watches a SIDE TABLE, not the truth: derive the prodded population from open assignments (Mike's diagnosis 2026-08-18). Today an open card is supervised only while a supervision_entitlements row exists with state armed/claimed; the sweep JOINs that table (supervision.ex population query) and the ladder reset lives inside the armed path. So the entitlement table is a SECOND source of truth about which work is being watched, and it can silently disagree with the assignments table — which is exactly what happened: the live 0.1.7 org has ELEVEN entitlements against hundreds of open cards, 301 open cards carry an exhausted ladder, and product-owner:surf-ace-codex sat six open cards with NO entitlement at all, permanently unwatchable, with the documented attest-reset repair unreachable because the reset requires the row it lost. Mike: 'why doesn't it just scan all cards to decide who to prod. this stinks of no single source of truth.' WANTED: the population is COMPUTED — every open assignment held by a live session is watched, full stop — with the entitlement row demoted to what it legitimately is, per-card PACING and lineage state (interval, dueAt, generation, basis), never the gate on whether a card is seen at all. A missing pacing row means default pacing, never invisibility. Terminus should mean 'stop pacing this card', not 'delete it from supervision's universe'. Note 0.2.0 still has this shape; the heard-prods fix (1935b65) corrected ladder COUNTING and did not touch the population gate. Philosophy: state is computed from rows; a question answerable from rows is answered by rows.

items.title: ROOT CAUSE — shipped guidance directs every agent to open a credential file, and that is why two credential incidents happened fifteen minutes apart. identity/guidance/operating-manual.md line 20 reads: "your own session key is in .tightbeam-session at the root of your workdir." That file holds three keys: sessionKey, url, and token — token being the bearer credential. So the anatomy layer instructs agents to open a secret-bearing file for a legitimate purpose: learning their own session key. EVIDENCE 2026-08-25: (1) 19:51:45 s_4b8eb312 wrote credential material into durable attest att_8c3e209c, 104s after spawn; contained by retiring the session, but the secret stays permanently readable by 174 sessions since attests are immutable with no redaction verb (wi_b9ec3102). (2) 20:06 the FRESH replacement reviewer on asg_e5e46142 read its credential file DESPITE AN EXPLICIT PROHIBITION; read only, not published; contained by retire and revoke. The second occurrence under an explicit ban proves this is not carelessness: the shipped manual told them where the key was, and an orchestrator's prohibition does not outrank the operating manual in an agent's reading. COLLISION: Mike's operator guidance says never read .tightbeam-session and the CLI is the only sanctioned path; the shipped manual points agents straight at it. Agents followed the one that shipped with the substrate. ACCEPTANCE: (1) remove or rewrite that manual line on BOTH 0.1.9 and 0.2.0; (2) a sanctioned way to learn your own sessionKey without touching a secret: a CLI verb, or state it in the card at dispatch; (3) separate identity from secret on disk, so a file an agent may legitimately read never carries a bearer token; (4) state in shipped kungfu that attests, artifacts, work items and decision requests are durable and org-readable and that credentials are named, never pasted. Until (1) lands, every per-agent prohibition is contradicted by the shipped manual.
